_note: What the voice reads, when it differs from what the child sees. Normal Japanese with kanji gives VOICEVOX the dictionary pitch accent; spaces (分かち書き for young readers) are removed before speaking anyway. generate_audio.py --check verifies each reading matches the hiragana. A value starting with kana: is VOICEVOX's accent notation (' = accent, _ = devoiced, / = phrase) for exact control.
